metadata.title: High-Contrast Latex Portrait with Integrated Lettering

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white studio portrait of a woman in glossy latex attire, featuring hand-painted white lettering that follows the contours of her arms and gloves. The lighting creates sharp highlights on the reflective surfaces and a soft, diffused shadow against a neutral background.
coreVisualRelationships: The white hand-painted text pops against the deep black glossy latex.
The wet-look hair texture mirrors the reflective quality of the latex clothing.
The subject's direct gaze creates a focal point balanced by the diagonal lines of her crossed arms.
coreInvariants: Strict monochrome palette (black, white, and grayscale).
High-gloss specular highlights on all dark surfaces.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, medium-close-up shot from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes, framed by wet-look bangs.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves down the crossed arms following the text, and circles back through the highlights on the latex.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Clean, light gray gradient background that allows the dark silhouette to stand out.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black with high-gloss white highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the hand-painted lettering.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value range from absolute black to blown-out white highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Visible brush strokes and uneven edges
Letters must warp and distort according to the three-dimensional form of the arms
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are stretched horizontally where the arm curves away from the camera

composition.scale: Large, filling the width of the arm

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single hand-painted style used for all text elements to maintain raw, DIY aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: To mimic the physical application of paint on latex.
As a base for manual warping if hand-painting is not possible.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white studio portrait of a woman with wet-look hair, wearing glossy black latex gloves and a strappy latex top, posed with arms crossed against a light gray background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-painted white acrylic-style lettering onto the surface of the latex gloves and forearms, ensuring the text warps naturally around the curves of the limbs.

verificationChecks: Text follows the 3D curvature of the arms.
Latex has sharp, bright specular highlights.
Lettering looks physically applied, not digitally overlaid.

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness

mustAchieve: Tactile paint quality on the text

postGenerationChecks: Does the text look like it's on the glove surface?
Is the lighting dramatic enough to create deep blacks?
Is the hair texture clearly 'wet' or 'gelled'?
Are the highlights on the latex crisp and white?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [High-Contrast Monochrome Photography] + [Glossy Latex Wardrobe] + [Integrated Hand-Painted Typography] to create a bold, tactile fashion visual.
